title: EGP Graphai • Lexical Map Codex
description: Keyed by root, in the language's original script. A key is any attested lexical root; keys are not restricted to one pattern because roots come from the lexicon rather than from a controlled vocabulary.

strongs.description: Strong's number, or an array of them when the tradition files one word under several numbers (an adverbial case form given its own entry, for instance). Same pattern as strongsNumber in content-schema.json. Must resolve in the lexicon (checked outside this schema).

indices.description: Lexical indices keyed by index name. On the root, the numbers the corpus uses for the word; on a cell, the number it tagged that form with.

occurrences.description: Attested token counts keyed by source version id, e.g. "BYZ2026". A cell with no `occurrences` is a paradigm cell no imported corpus has attested yet, which is expected and not an error.

parse.description: Category-tagged codes describing this cell's morphology. Every code must resolve in the language registry, at most one code per category, and required categories present for the part of speech; a variant's parse must be a subset of its canonical's parse (all checked outside this schema).

indices.description: Parse-level lexical indices, such as a defective-verb's own Strong's number. Never present on a variant cell (checked outside this schema).

cell.description: One parse of one spelling, with the index the corpus tagged it with. A spelling with several parses has several cells. Two spellings sharing a root and a parse are the same paradigm slot written two ways; nothing marks one as primary.

language.description: _id of the language registry this root belongs to, e.g. "greek".

pos.description: Part-of-speech code for this root. Resolves in the language registry's "pos" category (checked outside this schema).

citationForms.description: Optional citation forms, e.g. ["ὁ", "ἡ", "τό"] for a gender set filed under one root.

shortDefinition.description: Optional brief gloss for the root.

indices.description: Root-level lexical indices, for identifiers that belong to the word rather than to one parse cell.

inflections.description: Every attested inflected form under this root, keyed by the (normalized) surface spelling. Each form maps to a non-empty array of cells because one spelling can carry more than one parse. Every (form, parse) pair attested in a tagged corpus must exist here (checked outside this schema).

transliterations.description: Academic transliteration of every key in `inflections`, keyed the same way. Derived from the table in the language registry and stored so no consumer has to reimplement it.
